This format takes the course for a reader who works alone, without a facilitator and without a class, in five stages and at your own pace. The case study is a field experiment, in which emails that differed only in the name that signed them were sent to public housing authorities in the United States, and its claim is one of the original authors (OAs) [@EinsteinGlick2017DoesRaceAffect] that five analysts reanalysed for the robustness study of SCORE [Multi100\; @AczelEtAl2026InvestigatingAnalyticalRobustness]. The modules of the [companion curriculum](../../companion/index.qmd) sit between the tasks of the exercise, and the route ends on a project of your own. You leave with a case-study report and that project, both in a version-controlled repository that another person can clone and re-render.

## How you work

No programming is assumed. You work in the workspace of the case study on your own machine, in your IDE (Positron, RStudio, VS Code, etc.). Stage 1 installs R, Quarto, an IDE and the workspace, and stage 2 teaches enough R to start the case study. The deck and the browser lab, which run R inside your browser, hold every task as well, with hints and worked solutions. Either the deck or the browser lab carries the work if your installation fails.

[Install R and an IDE](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/setup.html){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"} [Open the browser lab](../../lab.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"}

Stage 1 takes Task 1 of the exercise, stage 3 Tasks 2 and 3, and stage 4 Tasks 4 and 5, and the [exercise](exercise.qmd) page sets out the five tasks. Each stage has a page that lists its steps in order. Where a stage can be shortened for a reader who already knows part of its material, its page says how, in a paragraph headed **Shortcuts**.

The stages use the [same deck as the day format](../day/slides.qmd). Open the deck in its own tab and press `s` for the speaker view, whose notes give what is said over each slide, and where a slide asks the class to write something and send it together, write it into your report instead. The [help page](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/help.html) lists the problems that other participants have met.

Sending your results to the class chart on the [Class results](../../class-results.qmd) page is optional.

## The stages

- [Stage 1 – Credibility and the three Rs](stage-1.qmd) (about five and a quarter hours)
- [Stage 2 – R and Quarto](stage-2.qmd) (about five hours)
- [Stage 3 – The claim and its reproduction](stage-3.qmd) (nearly six hours)
- [Stage 4 – The menu and the declaration](stage-4.qmd) (about six hours)
- [Stage 5 – Your own project](stage-5.qmd) (about six and a quarter hours)
